Wall_Over.slot: passive, Wall Line: the 5v5 wall module (2.6 m tall, 1.6 m thick)
Wall_Over.note: In place horizontally. The game moves the cobra forward at travel.speed for the whole clip, starting with the near face wall.near_face_ahead_m_at_start ahead of the model origin. Lifts the body to the wall height + 0.08 m.

Wall_Over_3m.slot: passive, Wall Line: the old arena walls (3 m tall, 1.2 m thick)
Wall_Over_3m.note: In place horizontally. The game moves the cobra forward at travel.speed for the whole clip, starting with the near face wall.near_face_ahead_m_at_start ahead of the model origin. Lifts the body to the wall height + 0.08 m.

Ghost_Run.note: Loop. A lower, quicker slither with the hood folded flat; planted at 6.0 m/s. The soft look is an effect, not in the clip.

Hood_Gaze.note: One-shot, in place. The hood flares wide with both plates swung forward. The cone fires at 'gaze'; 'release' is the end of the hold.

Seam_In.note: In place horizontally. The game moves the cobra forward at travel.speed for the whole clip, near face wall.near_face_ahead_m_at_start ahead at the start. It dives head-first into the foot of the wall at 40 degrees. At 'hidden' no part is outside the wall above the floor: hide the model and start the inside travel. It stays inside the wall for inside_s (2.0 s; Preston, 2026-11-13: "Seam stays inside the wall 2 seconds"), then Seam_Out plays.

Seam_Out.note: In place horizontally. Place the cobra so the exit face is wall.exit_face_ahead_m_at_start ahead of the origin, with the wall behind that face, and move it forward at travel.speed for the whole clip. 'emerge' is the snout clearing the face; 'clear' is the tail tip out. Blend to Idle or Walk after 'clear'.

Breach.note: In place horizontally. The game moves the cobra forward at travel.speed only between 'go' and 'stop'. Near face wall.near_face_ahead_m_at_start ahead at the start. 'burst' is the snout coming out of the far face: damage and knockback there. The wall section is soft, so nothing is checked against it (the game dissolves or hides it).
